S018.text: DeepDive compares recordings rather than releases, so it knows the difference between an unheard song and a duplicate, letting you quickly add to your library while creating your playlist.

S022.text: From your library, DeepDive can generate mixes based on when you found songs, release dates, even track length. With a Last.fm key you can also create similar artist discovery and genre mixes.
